## Preserved original contract and Phase A diagnosis

# A verification repair: resolve the prepared-source boundary behind 47 API failures


## Outcome, owner and current phase

Resolve the 47 outstanding API cases with honest, executable coverage at their required boundary, preserving the completed #935 repair. Child of #897. Existing A coordinator owns diagnosis, execution updates, sole assembly and resource serialization; Program Parent owns this bounded scope and its later implementation release. No replacement coordinator or new worker starts through creation.

Phase A, after actual issue creation/readback: coordinator read-only diagnosis and preparation. Implementation and runtime remain held until the concrete path/case/resource contract is recorded in this issue and Parent disposes it. This is a contract-completion step, not a request for routine Founder permission.

## Exact base and existing evidence

Latest verified assembled candidate: bc17e2bc86429d58536e4c3a749f51d9803cbd3a, non-documentation source cd7f4adb773f0a190dba74015ca2583f615c791b. Worker evidence b9bf4313c41d3b192021c203cfe1815a91921feb. Repin to the actual integration SHA before any later writer or runtime dispatch.

#935's 15-path repair and 21 raw-command hashes were independently audited by the coordinator. Clock 13/13 and proxy 5/5 pass, with API/admin TS7/TS6/lint passing. Its identical API selection removes exactly nine intended failures and adds none. Full selector remains exit1: 47 failures, 177 passes, no selected test omitted/skipped. Fresh assembled affected verification and independent source-readiness remain open.

Immutable evidence root:
https://github.com/Carberk/carberk/tree/b9bf4313c41d3b192021c203cfe1815a91921feb/docs/evidence/issue-897/a-pr904-audit-20261102/supplemental-repair-935/prerequisite-preparation-20261103

Read repair-terminal-handoff-r2.md, repair-api-red-confirmed.command.json/.raw.log, repair-api-green.command.json/.raw.log and repair-final-audit-r2.json. GREEN raw-log sha256 is 55b71af6fd5ec3545b5b42a7fac14843748bd00d67ed288692a5ed4dee0f45a4. These are preserved worker results, not new Parent/coordinator reruns.

## Phase A read scope and resources

Read source/tests/setup/config as needed; primary failing suites are:
- apps/api/src/modules/identity/presentation/DiagnosticContinuityHandoff.spec.ts: 27 failures.
- apps/api/src/modules/identity/presentation/DiagnosticScopedDiscovery.spec.ts: 13 failures.
- apps/api/src/modules/identity/infrastructure/ClassifiedForwardCapture.spec.ts: 6 failures.
- apps/api/src/modules/identity/presentation/DiagnosticErasedPredecessorReaders.spec.ts: 1 failure.

Trace their shared @auto-tm/db/testing exports, DiagnosticMemoryDatabase, diagnosticReaderFixture, diagnostic prepared-source commands, real API globalSetup/test database lifecycle and owning standards. DiagnosticMemoryDatabase.ts:102 explicitly refuses diagnostic_prepare_source with 'Prepared source acceptance requires real PostgreSQL'. Preserve that boundary. Existing 403/500 outcomes also require literal per-case diagnosis; a shared setup symptom is not proof every failure has one cause.

Phase A writes only new evidence under docs/evidence/issue-897/a-06-combined-ci-20261030/prepared-source-boundary-20261103/** and owned /tmp, after actual issue activation. No source/test/config/package/migration edit, install/build/test, database, service, port, storage, hosted/native/deploy/reset or PR action. No package/timing/runtime slot is allocated. Issue creation starts no implementation or resource.

Use codex_work/gpt-6.1-sol, xhigh/default for this diagnosis/review; medium/default for routine bookkeeping. Read back actual settings before any later dispatch. No Fast/priority, other reasoning level/provider, duplicate writer or polling.

## Required diagnosis and next implementation contract

1. Map all 47 exact failing case names to assertions, reached failure, relevant fixture and governing criterion. Reuse existing raw RED; no broad repeat merely to rediscover it.
2. Distinguish pure domain/port behavior from production repository/prepared-source/SQL behavior that needs real PostgreSQL. Identify the smallest lawful test seam and setup. Keep ordinary graph preparation, migration/hash/role/clock/lock/erasure invariants intact.
3. Propose the exact minimal implementation allow-list and canonical selectors. Any test classification/filename/command change must retain a one-to-one map of existing scenarios and assertions and their required CI admission; moving failures out of a selector cannot establish PASS.
4. Include frozen dependency/build/import preparation and conditional continuation. Derive API template/_w1 and dedicated Redis DB1 cleanup, worker-dist dependencies and any other resources from actual consumers. Specify fresh validated project/ports/databases/roles/object namespaces, exact argv, exclusive setup/run/cleanup interval and negative cleanup proof. Do not reuse a foreign or retained resource.
5. Return the concrete plan to Parent in the actual issue before source/runtime release. If production behavior, SQL/migration, permission or shared contract repair is needed, identify that separate source defect and stop at the current boundary.

## Dependencies and phase ordering

#935 provides the implemented clock/proxy prerequisite; this issue owns the unresolved boundary, not #935's mechanical caller contract. #936 is an independent small runtime-input repair and may proceed under its own recorded contract while this read-only planning occurs. Keep all source/shared resources serialized as required. Group compatible code-ready repairs into the same required exact-SHA independent #924/#934 review pair after affected prerequisites are satisfied.

A future small real-DB fixture probe is implementation verification only after its explicit reservation; it cannot stand in for #925's ten real cases or the other campaign/native/deployed/artifact gates. No phase cycle is created by requiring later acceptance proof to precede the setup/repair needed to obtain it.

## Commands and pass/fail acceptance

Phase A uses read-only git show and source inspection of the exact named evidence/base. The complete original API argv is immutable in repair-api-green.command.json: it selects the four suites above plus PrismaStaffAuthority.spec.ts, StaffAuthorityHttp.spec.ts, IdentityAuthorityPrepared.spec.ts, DiagnosticMaterialPrepared.spec.ts and DiagnosticReportsPrepared.spec.ts, maxWorkers1, AUTO_TM_TEST_DATABASES=off. Its recorded duration is 3.55344425s. Do not claim that turning database setup on alone supplies the correct fixtures or fixes all cases.

Before Phase B, record exact replacement/unchanged commands and all affected compiler/lint/runtime checks in the actual issue. Full outcome requires each of the original 47 cases or its explicitly approved equivalent to exercise the intended boundary and pass, the other selected scenarios to remain covered, source/applied/build identities and cleanup to be evidenced, and required independent review/combined CI on the resulting candidate. Prepared-source acceptance uses actual PostgreSQL behavior. Skips, in-memory emulation of SQL acceptance, weaker oracles, relaxed guards/timeouts, borrowed GREEN or reduced coverage fail acceptance.

Phase A passes only with a complete case map and dispatchable bounded plan. The whole issue remains OPEN until implementation, affected verification and required evidence pass. Parent alone accepts A. No production repair through Phase A, merge, signing/infrastructure change, B implementation, C-Activation, broad cleanup or release gate waiver.
